runner.credential_policy: Environment only. API keys, hosts, and headers are never written to repo artifacts, fixtures, receipts, prompts, or command arguments.

required_environment.QWEN_BASE_URL: OpenAI-compatible base URL; supplied at runtime
required_environment.QWEN_MODEL_SNAPSHOT: required pinned dated/snapshot model id; floating aliases are rejected

telemetry.usage_accounting: context budget uses peak single-response usage.total_tokens as the context-size proxy; cumulative billable_total_tokens is recorded separately and is not the R3 context budget dimension

enforcement.truncation_status_source: runner accumulated usage and ordered telemetry events

no-method.arm_purity_requirement: zero method-runtime operations and zero workspace method bootstrap

append-only.arm_purity_requirement: zero consolidation, supersession, collapse, or run_command operations

method-baseline.run_command_policy: whitelist only: runner constructs python <pinned weilan_trace.py> <args> and forces WEILAN_METHOD_HOME to the trial isolated method home; arbitrary shell strings are rejected
method-baseline.arm_purity_requirement: method runtime is expected and not scored as negative-control purity

arm_purity_observability.source: computed from actual telemetry, not arm_config declarations
arm_purity_observability.message_history_scan: runner records SHA-256 fingerprints plus marker hits for every message in the model history; raw text is not persisted in the telemetry artifact
arm_purity_observability.method_runtime_count: computed from actual run_command tool events plus method marker hits in message fingerprints
arm_purity_observability.bootstrap_count: computed from method bootstrap marker hits in message fingerprints
arm_purity_observability.append_only_forbidden_count: computed from forbidden tool events and collapse/supersession marker hits
